label: 🖼️ IMAGEN / CONCEPTO, TODAVÍA HAY QUE CONSTRUIRLO
note_lods: LOD1/LOD2 are mesh + skin only (share the LOD0 skeleton/clips); tris measured after decimate.
skeleton: Godot humanoid names (same bone map as Ironjaw), no finger bones

idle_spear.source: Blender arm edit of idle (336): RightUpperArm/LowerArm/Hand fixed, forearm forward, haft vertical, butt on the ground

behaviour.suggested_route: gate -> market square -> cathedral steps -> gate (loop, stop 6-10 s at each point, play idle = look around)
work_idles: idle_spear at the patrol stops (default idle), look-around idle with the spear slung
talk to the player when stopped
behaviour.rule: must always move or do something; never stand still more than ~10 s

mesh_source: Scenario Tripo v3.1 image-to-3D from the front crop (45 CU)

in_hand_reversed.note: same fist, spear flipped end-for-end, grip 0.75 m from the butt

spear.attach_note: BoneAttachment3D(bone) -> spear node with this transform, in glTF joint space with the joint scale removed (metres). Same scheme as Ironjaw. Verified by re-importing the exported LOD0 and placing the spear from these numbers only.

per_clip.sit: detached: lean the spear against the bench/wall 0.45 m to the right of the root, tilted 10 deg (not attached)

spear.grip: right hand sculpted into a hammer-grip fist around a 1.6 cm-radius haft (Ironjaw grip v3 method, finger wrap compressed 0.55); measured wrap about 300 deg; permanent, so the right hand is also a fist in talk/interact

textures.set: baseColor + NormalGL + ORM (R=occlusion, G=roughness, B=metallic), restored from the Tripo PBR output on all LODs

walk_speed_note: root speed that matches the planted foot of the in-place walk; move the NPC at this speed (scale the clip speed with the move speed) to avoid foot skating
